# Two CAD invoices taxed at 9.975%, one posted and one not.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-QST-POSTED, posted to the receivable, and
# INV-QST-DRAFT, not posted. `print-invoice --format plaintext` states the tax
# rate of each as 9.975, the figure the tax table stores, and the draft's page
# says it has no payment.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_printed_invoice_states_its_rate_as_stored.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:QST
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

taxtable "QST"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:QST"
		rate: 9.975%
		type: PERCENT

customer "C-QC"
	name: "Quebec Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-QST-POSTED"
	customer_id: "C-QC"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "QST"
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-QST-POSTED"
		accumulate: true
	payment: none

invoice "INV-QST-DRAFT"
	customer_id: "C-QC"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-02
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-02
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "QST"
	posted: none
